messages.subject: ggtree is broken
parts:
As a result of the insanity associated with geom-text deciding to place "a"s in figure legends, it is impossible to remove them without eliminating the legend shapes altogether. None of the suggested solutions works for this code:

p <- ggtree(Tree1, layout = "fan", branch.length="none") +
       geom_tiplab2(aes(color = Host, subset = grepl("UFVPY", label), label = gsub("UVFPY", "ufv", label)),
       show.legend = T, size = 6, offset =4) +
       guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(label = "", size = 8))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorsx25, aesthetics = c("color"),
      breaks = c("Cenchrus", "Cynodon", "Digitaria", "Eleusine", "Melinis",
      "Panicum", "Pennisetum", "Triticum", "Urochloa"))
